title: Canonicalize repeated percent-encoded search result URLs
description: Investigate and fix pi-search URLs that surface repeated percent-encoding such as %2525..., preserving useful canonical links or safely truncating malformed URLs. Do not edit pi-fast-mode.

logs.msg: Root cause: provider URLs pass through URL parsing that preserves nested percent encoding; shared cleanup only stripped fragments/host noise, and renderers emitted raw result/answer URLs. Implemented bounded cleanup of path tails matching nested %25 encoding, shared it with provider URL parsers, sanitized answer links to normalized returned sources, and bounded rendered URLs. Offline tests cover the help.openai.com-style URL and enrichment/rendering; typecheck and full test suite pass.
